title: Grateful Dead Live at Rose Palace on 1969-05-10
source: Cassette Master (Recorded By Bear on a Concord F-400 Cassette Deck) - Cassette (Ampex C-90) Playback Tascam 122 MK111 Cassette Deck No Dolby - Panasonic SV-3700 DAT @ 44.1KHz (DL)

ai_review.summary: Soundboard source plagued by severe diginoise after 14:00, yet the Dark Star segment burns with high‑energy playing.
ai_review.review: The show’s musical heart – especially a red‑hot Dark Star that showcases tight interplay and soaring organ work – is praised by several listeners. Unfortunately the recording suffers from heavy tape degradation, metallic doubling of Garcia's guitar and intermittent over‑saturation, making a large portion almost unlistenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Show performance (especially Dark Star) is rated positively while the recording quality is widely criticized; weighted average yields a modest overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Severe diginoise and metallic doubling of Garcia's guitar from ~14:00 onward, tape degradation, interference and occasional over‑saturation; early portion clearer but overall marred.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Limited commentary on set structure; Dark Star and the closing medley are highlighted as special despite technical setbacks.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar is both praised for responsive interplay and criticized for metallic doubling noise after 14:00.
band_member_comments.Keys: Organ work described as ‘really nice’ and a clear cue for Jerry’s improvisation during Dark Star.
